key_interactions.effect: Severe bradycardia, asystole and heart failure reported (label).
Additive slowing of heart rate and AV conduction (label).

key_interactions.action: Withdraw the beta-blocker several days before tapering clonidine.

key_interactions.effect: Patients with severe allergic reactions may not respond to usual epinephrine doses (label).
